text: Decision (lead, under the owner's 2026-11-01 rules: systematic unless proven local, no fallback or legacy anywhere; and the recorded cutover direction O1 'the stamp must carry identities from the log', with in-place upgrade ruled unsupported 2026-10-04): implement Option A of evidence/transition.md section 6. The partition ADD conf change commits {replicaIdentity, peerId, nodeId} as its context and every replica records it at apply; raft_rs_peer_identity gains node_id by the learner_admission ALTER precedent with no decoder for the old format; snapshot checkpoint peer reservations carry nodeId; READ_COMMITTED_MEMBERSHIP returns identities with nodeId; the proof handler decides from the committed configuration plus progress keyed by peer id (etcd Progress[id].Match shape) and probes by id; the port's transport resolver, snapshot catch-up and raft delivery resolve addresses from the committed fact; the services-cache resolution paths, learner_address_unresolvable and the re-assert wake are deleted. Option B (transport stays cache-backed) is rejected as a projection-level partial fix of the class. The message-group peer resolver is recorded as a named follow-up if its admission path differs. Owner may veto before landing; nothing lands without independent verification.

Option A built on wip/learner-host-admission-20261101 head e532dacba (base f70f43a29): partition and message-group ADD commit {replicaIdentity, peerId, nodeId} as conf-change context; every replica records node_id at apply (raft_rs_peer_identity.node_id, written once from a committed fact, conflict fails the apply); snapshot peer reservations carry nodeId when recorded; stamps and the committed-membership read expose nodeIds beside identities; leader progress keyed by replica identity; partition transport resolver = committedPartitionPeerAddress with typed per-peer peer_not_in_configuration; proof order NOT_LEADER -> NOT_IN_CONFIGURATION -> progress, CONFIGURATION_UNAVAILABLE typed. Deleted: learner_address_unresolvable (3 files), the re-assert wake, reconcileLocalOnlyServiceRowsNow, buildPeerAddress/resolveKnownPeerAddress/peerAddresses, the init-loop cache admission of bootstrap peers, the dead stale-address REMOVE/re-ADD, src/raft/peer-address-resolver.js. Evidence: 21/21 quest tests (a)-(g); dt6-learner-promotion-proof-channel-wake 11/11 incl. a drive of the live defect; lab cone 1854/1863 (5 base-red/flaky, 2 pass locally, 1 slow-host timeout, 1 fixed). Scenario fresh-formation-user-table-routability (3 nodes on 2 machines, one run each): predicates f and g now MET; leader proof refusals 18x learner_address_unresolvable -> 0; serve lane still never opens in 420 s because admission is triggered by the learner's services row appearing in the seed's cache and that row never reaches the cache (C1/C10: cdc_committed_acceptance_unknown 6771x; node_ready_lease_incomplete 296x). Decision: this instance (C2/C3) is a bounded repair with its own regression evidence; the scenario remains red for another cause (admission trigger from a projection, C1/C10) -> next bounded quests: replica-admission-from-committed-operation (trigger admission from the REPLACE operation authority, not the cache row) and write-answers-at-commit-position; the message-group learner context (frozen six-key learner_admission) is a named follow-up. The quest's scenario-level doneWhen will be superseded explicitly (R09) to the instance witnesses before sealing.
